objective: Open the interpreter, evaluate arithmetic, print a message, and leave interactive mode.
review_note: Actual terminal instructions and TRY_THIS reviewed; Spanish companion is an alternate-language representation. TRY_THIS uses an undefined your_age name, so define it before evaluating that optional expression.

objective: Print text, numbers, expressions, and a short story with correctly paired quotes.
review_note: The runnable example is teaching material; assigned work is changing messages and writing the TRY_THIS story.

objective: Create and run a script, explain top-to-bottom execution, and use comments to disable and restore a line.
review_note: Actual code and all three TRY_THIS steps reviewed.

objective: Store and update personal facts, calculate with variables, and swap values using a temporary variable.
review_note: The temporary-variable swap is a prerequisite-friendly introduction; the later no-temporary-variable challenge remains distinct practice.

objective: Compare integer and floating-point arithmetic, calculate time and prices, and inspect a division-by-zero error.
review_note: Source's // explanation says it drops the decimal part; this is inaccurate for negative operands. Flag floor-division caveat and teach actual floor semantics in the earlier numbers lesson.

objective: Combine and format text, inspect string methods, fix nested quotes, and repeat strings.
review_note: The split example briefly produces a list but does not yet require list manipulation; formal list work follows.

objective: Read names and numeric input, build a tip calculator, and observe failed string-to-number conversion.
review_note: Invalid numeric input is intentionally demonstrated rather than handled; exception-handling assignments come later.

objective: Predict branches and build age and number-guess checks with compound conditions.
review_note: The fixed password example is a condition demonstration, not a secure authentication design.

objective: Create, index, change, and aggregate lists; investigate an out-of-range access.
review_note: Full code and TRY_THIS inspected; no iteration required for the assigned list edits.

objective: Iterate over lists and ranges, accumulate scores, and print multiplication and countdown sequences.
review_note: All examples and three variations reviewed; count-down range uses a negative step.

objective: Repeat until a condition changes, validate repeated guesses, and stop a deliberate infinite loop.
review_note: The deliberate infinite loop must be run interactively and stopped with Ctrl+C, not in unattended test execution.

objective: Store labeled records, count words, iterate over key-value pairs, and compare missing-key access with get().
review_note: Dictionary iteration introduces simple two-name unpacking; deeper unpacking practice is later.

objective: Define reusable functions with parameters, return values, and defaults; implement conversion, average, and parity helpers.
review_note: The source includes supplied examples; TRY_THIS contains the original independent function work.

objective: Read a supplied text dataset, parse rows, count lines, and identify the highest-scoring student.
review_note: Source uses unclosed open() calls, although its comment supplies a safer with-open form. Note resource-management limitation; verify data/sample.txt before final inclusion.

objective: Extend the student grade reporter with new records, filtering, alternate data, and optional report-file output.
concepts: functions;lists of dictionaries;file parsing;format specifications;generator expressions
review_note: Full implementation and four TRY_THIS variations reviewed. Baseline contains generator expressions and depends on the previous exercise's sample file; schedule after those skills, not solely by the beginner folder label.

objective: Implement named constants and cooking-time functions with parameters, return values, and docstrings.
review_note: Full instructions, introduction, starter contract and executable test cases reviewed. Starter intentionally omits a parameter and other functions; this is learner work, not a defect. Tests explicitly check docstrings.

objective: Express four arcade-game outcomes as reusable Boolean functions.
review_note: Instructions and all supplied Boolean cases reviewed. Keeps useful truth-table practice distinct from condition-branch exercises.

objective: Not assigned: deprecated power-billing exercise has contradictory API names and a dimensionally invalid energy conversion.
review_note: Instructions demand get_kW_value/get_kWh_value, while starter and tests demand get_kW_amount/get_kwh_amount. Watts divided by 1000 then 3600 is not an energy calculation without duration. Reference tests pass their own legacy contract but do not resolve these instruction defects; Currency Exchange is the stronger arithmetic assignment.

objective: Calculate currency conversion, whole-bill counts, remainders, and fee-adjusted exchange value.
review_note: Actual six-function requirements and all supplied numeric test cases reviewed. Follow primary instructions and tests; a floating-denomination docstring example is outside the stated integer-denomination contract. This is arithmetic practice, not financial advice or production currency handling.

objective: Classify simulated reactor conditions using compound comparisons, efficiency bands, and threshold intervals.
review_note: Read complete instructions and test data around criticality and efficiency boundaries. Retain as progressive branching practice; check 90% and 110% boundaries against the written inclusive specification.

objective: Implement card values, ties, ace choices, and hand decisions from a six-part rule specification.
review_note: Full instructions and every supplied hand case reviewed. Extra tuple prerequisite added despite track metadata omitting it; equal-valued cards must return the original card pair.

objective: Clean an essay's titles, sentence endings, surrounding whitespace, and word choices.
review_note: Full four-part brief, starter contract and tests reviewed, including absent replacement words and one-sided whitespace.

objective: Transform vocabulary using prefixes, joined word groups, suffix spelling rules, and indexed sentence words.
review_note: Read full brief, introduction and test cases. Unlike its minimal track prerequisites, this task requires list indexing and splitting; schedule after basic lists. Preserve its string-method approach rather than requiring loops.

objective: Render an event handbill with exact-width borders, formatted dates, Unicode icons, and missing optional data.
review_note: WIP source mixes obsolete class/method examples with module-function starter/tests. Preserve only as an explicitly annotated optional challenge using the actual four-function test contract; missing dates and missing icons are covered. Confirm reference-test result before final disposition.

objective: Track and combine card rounds, compare positional averages, and update the final card under a game rule.
review_note: Complete instructions, stubs and test data reviewed. The stated median means the positional middle element of an odd-length hand; do not add a sorting requirement that the source does not ask for.

objective: Manage express and normal queues while distinguishing in-place changes from sorted copies.
review_note: Complete instructions and tests reviewed. One queue-identity test incorrectly compares the built-in type object with 0/1 and never executes its assertions; record this coverage defect. Preserve the assignment's in-place requirement from its written brief.

objective: Round scores, filter failing and high-scoring students, construct grade intervals, and rank or locate students.
review_note: All six requirements and actual cases reviewed, including round(0.5), round(1.5), empty inputs, non-divisible grade ranges, and first-match behavior.

objective: Normalize coordinate representations, match and combine treasure records, and produce a cleaned multiline report.
review_note: Full five-part brief and all supplied tuple/report test data reviewed. Formatting and the final newline are part of the tested contract.

objective: Create, increment, decrement, remove, and list stock entries without letting counts become negative.
review_note: Full instructions and tests reviewed, including absent decrement targets and absent removals. The example's item order is not an explicit rule and supplied tests do not distinguish sorted from insertion order; do not invent an ordering requirement.

objective: Build cart and recipe operations, preserve requested dictionary ordering, and reconcile fulfillment against stock.
review_note: Full six-part brief and test bodies reviewed. Tests import separate dict_methods_test_data.py, which requires resource-level review. Distinguish notes initialized at one per distinct item from add-item frequency increments.

objective: Repair train lists and routing dictionaries using argument packing, iterable unpacking, and matrix transposition.
review_note: Full five-part brief, incomplete starter signatures and all supplied cases reviewed. Changing signatures to accept arbitrary positional/keyword arguments is intentional learner work; do not assign this solely after basic dictionaries.

objective: Deduplicate and classify ingredients, combine shopping needs, and separate restricted or singleton items using sets.
review_note: All seven instructions, starter contracts and test logic reviewed. Supplied category and test datasets remain support files. Source docstring loosely describes category intersections; use the brief's provided repeated-ingredient set, not an intersection-of-all-dishes interpretation.

objective: Model independent alien state, shared creation counts, methods, and a factory for collections of aliens.
review_note: Complete seven-part brief and all executable cases reviewed. A no-op collision_detection is explicitly required, so its pass/None behavior is intentional scaffolding, not an incomplete task.

objective: Yield seat identifiers and fixed-width ticket codes lazily, skip row 13, and map passengers to seats.
review_note: Full instructions and every test reviewed, including inspect.isgenerator and row-13 skipping. Generators are a required contract; eagerly returning a list is not equivalent.

objective: Parse log severities into enums, produce numeric short forms, expose an alias, and enumerate canonical members.
review_note: WIP API mismatch: instructions use title-case enum names, while tests require uppercase members and import LogLevelInt, absent from the starter. Preserve as an annotated optional challenge only, with the existing test/reference identifiers made explicit; do not silently pretend the instructions are complete.

objective: Not assigned: reservation expectations contradict the task's stated guest order and completeness.
review_note: Full six-part instructions and test bodies reviewed. arrange_reservations must seat Walter first under the prose, but test_arrange_reservations_1 expects Walter omitted and Frank first. Tests also call an undocumented no-argument form. Reference passes its tests, but that cannot reconcile the contradictory contract; quarantine pending source repair.

objective: Implement a zero-argument function that returns the exact greeting and passes its test.
review_note: Actual test distinguishes return from print. Preserve as a return-contract exercise, distinct from the earlier print-based Hello World.

objective: Determine Gregorian leap years with divisibility and century exceptions.
review_note: Read introduction's complete 4/100/400 rule and all century-boundary tests; the one-line instructions alone omit the essential rule.

objective: Classify valid triangle side lists as equilateral, isosceles, or scalene.
review_note: Full instructions and tests reviewed. Equilateral counts as isosceles; degenerate equality cases are explicitly untested and optional, so do not impose an unsupported strict choice.

objective: Calculate chessboard doubling totals and reject invalid square numbers with the required exception message.
review_note: Read instructions, introduction, append and every test. Source metadata omits the exception prerequisite; move after raising exceptions rather than basic arithmetic alone.

objective: Recognize numbers equal to the sum of their digits raised to the digit count.
review_note: All numeric cases read, including zero and seven-digit examples. Requires iteration or equivalent digit processing despite minimal upstream prerequisites.

objective: Count iterative Collatz transitions and raise the specified ValueError for nonpositive inputs.
review_note: Full introduction explains the transitions; append adds required error message absent from the short primary statement. All cases reviewed, including one and a million.

objective: Apply ordered response rules to questions, shouting, silence, and ordinary statements.
review_note: All whitespace, punctuation, numeric-only and combined shouting-question tests reviewed. Keep after string methods, which its track prerequisite list omits.

objective: Compose ordered sound fragments for factors of 3, 5, and 7, falling back to numeric text.
review_note: Read primary, introduction, Python-specific append and tests. Distinct useful follow-up to FizzBuzz because simultaneous factors concatenate multiple fragments.

objective: Score Cartesian landing points against concentric circle boundaries.
review_note: Full brief and all edge/axis/diagonal cases reviewed. Points exactly on each circle count inside that circle.

objective: Classify positive integers by the sum of their proper divisors and reject invalid input.
review_note: Read complete spec, exception append, and all tests. Tests include values above 33 million, so place after factorization and cost reasoning despite upstream difficulty 1.

objective: Return reversed text while preserving punctuation, empty input, and Unicode code points.
review_note: Full brief and tests reviewed, including wide CJK characters. Stronger main-path reference for the overlapping learn.python reverse-string challenge, which can remain optional practice.

objective: Check case-insensitively whether text contains every English alphabet letter.
review_note: Full instruction/context and all cases reviewed. Numbers cannot substitute for missing letters, and 26 distinct mixed-case characters need not cover the alphabet.

objective: Detect repeated letters while ignoring case, spaces, and repeated hyphens.
review_note: Read all supplied mixed-case, empty, spaced and repeated-hyphen tests. Distinct from pangram: it checks uniqueness rather than alphabet coverage.

objective: Validate ISBN-10 length, characters, check-digit position, and weighted checksum with or without hyphens.
review_note: Complete specification and every invalid-input test reviewed. Only the final check position may contain X; invalid letters cannot be silently discarded to make a valid length.

objective: Rotate alphabetic characters by a key while retaining case, punctuation, spaces and digits.
review_note: Read full brief, stub and all tests, including wraparound and unchanged nonletters. Historical cipher exercise, not a modern encryption implementation.

objective: Map a DNA sequence to its specified RNA complements, including empty input.
review_note: Read brief, introduction and every test. Complements are G:C, C:G, T:A and A:U. No unrequested invalid-input behavior added.

objective: Look up the numeric code for a resistor band and return the ordered color list.
review_note: Read complete task and tests. Foundation of the progressively harder four-exercise resistor sequence, not redundant with multi-band variants.

objective: Decode the first two color bands as a decimal number and ignore any extra bands.
review_note: All cases reviewed, including leading black yielding a single digit and ignoring a third color.

objective: Decode a third multiplier band and format a resistance label using metric units.
review_note: Full brief and tests read. Tests require megaohms and gigaohms as well as the briefly introduced kiloohms; extra colors are ignored.

objective: Decode one-, four- and five-band resistors with tolerance percentages and decimal metric labels.
review_note: Full instructions, introduction and tests reviewed. Single black band has no tolerance label; five-band examples require fractional metric labels such as 2.54 megaohms.

objective: Decode five binary-string positions into ordered actions and optionally reverse the action list.
review_note: Append overrides generic number-input prose: Python API takes a binary string. All tests reviewed, including zero and reversing an empty action list. Bitwise arithmetic is not required.

objective: Find case-insensitive anagrams while excluding the same word and preserving candidate spelling.
review_note: Full specification and tests reviewed. Contrary to brief's ASCII-only claim, supplied tests require Greek letters too. Set equality alone fails repeated-letter counts; checksum equality also fails.

objective: Generate an inclusive range of cumulative nursery-rhyme verses from reusable phrases.
review_note: Read all verses and exact single/multiple/full-rhyme expectations. Returns a list of single-line verses, not the display-form multiline text. Recursive implementation is optional, not a prerequisite.

objective: Find the original index of an item in a sorted list by repeatedly halving the search interval.
review_note: Full brief, append and tests reviewed. Missing values, including empty input and crossed bounds, require ValueError with exact message value not in array. Unlike metadata, exceptions must come first.

objective: Count differing positions in equal-length DNA sequences and reject mismatched lengths.
review_note: All instructions and test bodies read, including either strand empty. Exact error message is Strands must be of equal length. Generator expressions are an optional refinement rather than a requirement.

objective: Flatten arbitrarily nested lists while preserving integers, including zero, and omitting None.
review_note: Full brief and tests reviewed. Five- and six-level nesting prevent a single-level flatten. Truthiness filtering would incorrectly discard zero. Explicit-stack traversal is a valid alternative after stacks.

objective: Format a customer greeting with the correct ordinal suffix, including the 11, 12 and 13 exceptions.
review_note: Full brief, introduction and tests read. Tests span one to three digits; checking only the last digit fails 112. Source metadata omits conditionals and arithmetic requirements.

objective: Compute square of a sum, sum of squares and their difference for the first N natural numbers.
review_note: Complete brief, stubs and nine tests reviewed. Closed-form optimization can follow complexity lessons; source explicitly permits researching efficient formulas but does not require deriving them first.

objective: Implement append, one-level concatenation, filter, length, map, directional folds and reversal without existing equivalents.
review_note: All eight contracts and test bodies reviewed. concat removes one nesting level only, unlike Flatten Array. Direction-dependent division and string fold tests establish argument order; metadata understates callable prerequisites.

objective: Transform score-to-letter-group data into a lowercase-letter-to-score mapping.
review_note: Read complete instructions, introduction and all four fixtures. This is an in-memory transformation exercise, not a database or external ETL project.

objective: Implement a SpaceAge class with planet-specific methods converting seconds to rounded orbital years.
review_note: Read all docs and tests. Python append requires a class and eight on_planet methods despite registry omitting classes. Uses exercise-defined Earth-year seconds, not a calendar-age calculator.

objective: Sum unique multiples of supplied factors strictly below a limit, including zero and empty-factor cases.
review_note: All docs and cases reviewed. Append claims sorted factors but test passes [3,0], so do not rely on sorted order. Zero must not trigger division-by-zero or zero-step range.

objective: Return a datetime exactly one billion seconds after a supplied moment.
review_note: Full brief, append, introduction and five tests read. Accepts and returns datetime, including exact day rollover; does not require authoring a class despite registry prerequisite.

objective: Return a personalized sentence with a default name when called without an argument.
review_note: Brief, introduction, stub and three tests read. Learner must change the stub signature to permit no argument. Sets are not required, despite track prerequisite metadata.

objective: Compute the integer square root of a positive perfect square without library root functions or exponentiation shortcuts.
review_note: Full docs and six tests reviewed. Perfect-square positive inputs only; no invented nonsquare/negative handling. Keep source's no-built-in constraint. Narrative claim that library math necessarily uses more power is unsupported, not a lesson objective.

objective: Translate words and phrases with ordered vowel, consonant-cluster, qu, xr, yt and y rules.
review_note: Read all four rules and all cases. Requires strings and iteration beyond registry's conditionals-only prerequisites. Initial y is consonant; y after a consonant cluster is vowel-like.

objective: Verify that three kinds of brackets are matched and correctly nested while ignoring other text.
review_note: Complete brief and tests read, including crossing pairs, unexpected early closers, unfinished openers, math and LaTeX. Counting each bracket kind alone is insufficient.

objective: Classify equality and contiguous containment of two lists using four distinct exported constants.
review_note: Full brief, stub docstring and every test reviewed. Containment is contiguous, not subset membership. Tests include million-element input, overlapping false starts and values that must not be confused through string conversion.

objective: Encode and decode reversed-alphabet substitution with lowercase normalization, retained digits and five-character groups.
review_note: Full instructions and all encode/decode tests read. Punctuation removed, numbers retained, decode ignores arbitrary spacing and does not restore original word boundaries. Adds grouping and normalization beyond Rotational Cipher.

objective: Return a square, horizontally and vertically symmetric letter diamond with exact padding.
review_note: Full requirements and all expected rows reviewed, including Z. API returns list of rows rather than printing; trailing spaces are significant and must not be stripped.

objective: Count set bits in a nonnegative integer without using built-in bit counting.
review_note: Full instructions, introduction and all tests read. Includes zero and 2,000,000,000; bit_count is explicitly forbidden, unlike a mere shortcut preference.

objective: Translate three-character RNA codons to amino-acid names and stop at the first stop codon.
review_note: Full codon table, rules and every test read. Process nonoverlapping triples; do not resume after a stop codon or emit STOP in result. Invalid/incomplete-codon behavior is unspecified and not invented.

objective: Return repeated prime factors in ascending order while reducing the remaining quotient.
review_note: Full brief and all tests read, including 93,819,012,551. One returns empty list. Large-prime case motivates square-root stopping rather than scanning every integer up to original input.

objective: Express integers up to 999,999,999,999 in English words with correct scale groups and hyphens.
review_note: Complete instructions, append and all expected text reviewed. No and between hundreds and tens. Exact out-of-range error required for negative or trillion input. Helper decomposition can be iterative or recursive.

objective: Build an uppercase acronym while treating hyphens as word separators and removing other punctuation.
review_note: Full brief and all cases read. Apostrophes and underscores must not create extra initials. Regular expressions are an optional technique despite practice metadata, not a required prerequisite.

objective: Return every fixed-length contiguous digit substring in input order with explicit invalid-length errors.
review_note: Full brief, append, starter and tests reviewed. Preserve leading zeros and repeated windows. Empty source, zero length, negative length and excessive length have different required error messages; append's slice() name is a typo, API is slices().

objective: Compress consecutive character runs and decode multi-digit run counts while retaining case and whitespace.
review_note: Full brief and all tests read. Single runs omit the count, spaces are data, and unencoded inputs contain no digits. Regex is optional. Round-trip property supplies stronger verification than individual examples alone.

objective: Generate primes to find a one-based nth prime and reject indexes below one.
review_note: Read complete instructions, append and tests. Includes 10,001st prime, so inefficient naive full-divisor search should follow optimization instruction. Generators are an optional implementation, not forced by tests. No standard-library prime shortcut.
